territorial_scope.description: Applies to datacenters at a single location in South Carolina, under the state sales and use tax.

evidence.quote: a new or existing facility at a single location in South Carolina

summary.short: Exempts from South Carolina sales and use tax the purchase of computer equipment used within a qualifying datacenter and the electricity used by it, for facilities certified by the Department of Commerce that meet investment and job thresholds. Applies to datacenters certified before January 1, 2032.
summary.long: Item (79) of Section 12-36-2120 exempts from the state sales and use tax (A)(1) original or replacement computers, computer equipment, and computer hardware and software purchases used within a datacenter, and (A)(2) electricity used by a datacenter and eligible business property located there; other electricity sales remain taxable. Subitem (B) defines a datacenter as a facility at a single location in South Carolina with concurrently maintainable power and cooling, a capital investment of at least fifty million dollars by a taxpayer over five years (or seventy-five million aggregate by one or more taxpayers), at least twenty-five full-time jobs at average cash compensation of 150% of per capita income (State or county, whichever is lower), and those jobs maintained for three consecutive years. Under subitems (C) and (D), the taxpayer notifies the Department of Revenue and the Department of Commerce, and may claim the exemption on eligible purchases once Commerce certifies the facility; limitation periods are suspended. Subitem (E) extends the exemption to later purchases and investments. Subitem (F) allows assessment of tax if requirements are not met and reduces the electricity exemption in proportion to qualifying jobs below twenty-five. Subitem (G) applies to datacenters certified before January 1, 2032, continues for ten years for those certified by December 31, 2031, and is then repealed.

notes: Item (79) is annotated from the chapter-length text, so extent is partial (item 79 only). The text's history notes do not identify the act that added item (79). Item (79)(G) sunsets the item: it applies only to datacenters certified before 1 January 2032, with a further ten-year period for those certified by 31 December 2031, after which the subitem is repealed. The text defines 'computer equipment' separately in item (79)(B)(2) and item (65)(c), with different wording on cooling equipment. Section 12-54-85 is cross-referenced but not included in the document.
